identity_source_locator.primary_source_statement: Figure 3 shows the mature 50-residue SpliDef peptide; Results text reports 23-residue signal peptide, 27-residue propeptide, and 50-residue mature peptide.

assay_conditions.method: agar disk diffusion growth-inhibition zone assay
assay_conditions.sample_volume: 5 uL haemolymph or purified protein sample on 6 mm paper disk
assay_conditions.medium_and_inoculum: 0.6% LB agar mixed with 100 uL viable bacterial suspension at 1.6e9 cells/mL
assay_conditions.readout: inhibition zone diameters measured after 24-48 h; growth inhibition evaluated after 16 h by comparison with positive control
assay_conditions.positive_control: penicillin 10 mg/disc; reference inhibition zones 13 +/- 1 mm diameter

replicates_statistics.statistics: Five inhibition-zone replicates were measured; Table 3 reports qualitative categories rather than per-target numeric zone means.

source_locator.label: Table 3
source_locator.caption: Antibacterial activity of the immunized haemolymph and the purified mature defensin peptide on gram (-) and gram (+) bacteria.
source_locator.column_context: immunized haemolymph; 24 h p.i.

legend.(+): inhibition zone less than 1 mm surrounding the 6 mm paper disk
legend.+++: inhibition more than 10 mg penicillin positive-control disk; reference zones 13 +/- 1 mm diameter

source_column_context.value_meaning: inhibition comparable to positive control

identity_source_locator.primary_source_statement: Figure 3 shows the mature 50-residue SpliDef peptide; Results text reports 23-residue signal peptide, 27-residue propeptide, and 50-residue mature peptide.

assay_conditions.method: agar disk diffusion growth-inhibition zone assay
assay_conditions.sample_volume: 5 uL haemolymph or purified protein sample on 6 mm paper disk
assay_conditions.medium_and_inoculum: 0.6% LB agar mixed with 100 uL viable bacterial suspension at 1.6e9 cells/mL
assay_conditions.readout: inhibition zone diameters measured after 24-48 h; growth inhibition evaluated after 16 h by comparison with positive control
assay_conditions.positive_control: penicillin 10 mg/disc; reference inhibition zones 13 +/- 1 mm diameter

replicates_statistics.statistics: Five inhibition-zone replicates were measured; Table 3 reports qualitative categories rather than per-target numeric zone means.

source_locator.label: Table 3
source_locator.caption: Antibacterial activity of the immunized haemolymph and the purified mature defensin peptide on gram (-) and gram (+) bacteria.
source_locator.column_context: Ni-affinity purified mature SpliDef peptide; 48 h p.i.

legend.(+): inhibition zone less than 1 mm surrounding the 6 mm paper disk
legend.+++: inhibition more than 10 mg penicillin positive-control disk; reference zones 13 +/- 1 mm diameter
